title: Clipper: a guided tour
summary: A tour of Clipper 1.3.1 on the FM-1, a one-instrument synth firmware: the HOME screen, browsing the 407 sounds, the knobs and sound pages, effects, scales and chords, the arpeggiator, recording, the step sequencer, the GLO pages, user presets and the menu.
author: Claude Code draft 2026-11-15

steps.title: Welcome to Clipper
steps.text: Clipper is a synthesizer firmware: one instrument with 23 engines, not a groovebox. HOME shows the sound's name, its family, its number in the list, the engine and a live scope. Tap HOME from any page to come back; tapped on HOME it opens the visualiser, and HOME again closes it.

steps.title: Play the keys
steps.text: The keys F3 to G5 play the sound. OCT- and OCT+ shift the octave; press both together to reset it. MASTER sets the volume. Pitch bend, mod wheel, aftertouch and sustain from a MIDI keyboard work on every engine.

steps.title: Browse the sounds
steps.text: On HOME, PRESETS steps through every sound one by one: 407 factory sounds, then your user presets. It only browses on HOME and the PRESETS page, so a stray turn elsewhere never throws away the sound you are editing.

await.hint: Turn PRESETS and play a key

steps.title: Jump by family
steps.text: ALGORITHM jumps to the next family of sounds: PAD, BASS, LEAD, PLCK, KEYS, STAB, FX and the rest. Use it to get near what you want, then PRESETS to pick the sound.

await.hint: Turn ALGORITHM to jump to another family

steps.title: The four knobs
steps.text: On HOME, KNOB1 to KNOB4 play the sound's main controls, shown on the screen. On a HYBRID sound (Clipper's own engine) they are CUT, RES, M1 and M2. On every other page the knobs set the four columns shown.

await.hint: Turn a knob and play a key

steps.title: EDIT and SELECT
steps.text: Tap EDIT for the engine's pages (EDIT 1, EDIT 2), then VOICE 1-3, MACROS, LAYER, MORPH, RANDOM and UNDO (the sound's history and COMPARE). Tap the button again for the next page, or turn SELECT to walk the pages of the family both ways.

await.hint: Turn SELECT to see another EDIT page

steps.title: Envelopes and modulation
steps.text: ENV opens ENV (the amp ADSR), ENV DEST, ENV 2 and ENV 2 LOOP. LFO opens LFO, LFO DEST, MOD (velocity, mod wheel, aftertouch), LFO 2, LFO 3, the 12-slot MATRIX and the four-lane MOD SEQ. ENV and LFO only open pages: they have no held layer.

steps.title: Effects
steps.text: Tap FX for the sends (FX), then FILTER (with MODL, the filter model), INSERT, INSERT 2, DLY, DLY 2 (MONO, PING, TAPE), REVERB (ROOM, PLATE, HALL, SHIMMER), CHORUS and EQ+COMP. While FX is held the keys still play.

await.hint: Tap FX to see the next effects page

steps.title: Key, scale and chords
steps.text: The SCL button is SEL on Clipper's screen. Tap it for SEL (ROOT, SCL, QNT keys, CHORD) and SEL 2 (TRN, STRUM, VLEAD). Hold it and press a key to set the key; held, KNOB1 to KNOB4 set CHORD, SCALE, KEYS and TRANSPOSE.

steps.title: Arpeggiator
steps.text: Tap ARP for the arpeggiator: KNOB1 sets MODE (OFF, UP, DN, UPDN, RND, ORD, CHORD, TURNG, a Turing machine, and more), then RATE, OCT and GATE. Tap again for ARP 2 and SPICE. Hold ARP for note repeat on the keys.

await.hint: Tap ARP to open the arpeggiator

steps.title: Play and tempo
steps.text: PLAY starts and stops the pattern. On HOME, SELECT sets the tempo (on a page it walks the pages instead). The tempo, swing and metronome are also on GLO's GLOBAL page.

await.hint: Press PLAY to start, and again to stop

steps.title: Record a pattern
steps.text: REC records what you play into the pattern. While playing it records at once; while stopped it arms, and your first note starts the take. Tap REC again for REC OFF. Hold REC to clear the pattern.

steps.title: The step sequencer
steps.text: Hold SEQ: the 16 white keys are the 16 steps. Hold a step and turn KNOB1 (note), KNOB2 (velocity), KNOB3 (ratchet) or KNOB4 (nudge). Tap SEQ for NOTES, a piano roll, then PATTERN (LEN, DIV, SWING, GATE). Hold EDIT to erase; OCT-/OCT+ undo and redo.

await.hint: Tap SEQ to see the next page

steps.title: The GLO pages
steps.text: Tap GLO for GLOBAL (tempo, swing, metronome, fine tune), MASTER, TUNING (scales and A4 from 400 to 480 Hz), SYSTEM, MIDI and MIDI 2. Hold GLO for a fill (key 9), a fill bar (key 10), tap tempo (key 16) and the level on KNOB1.

steps.title: Save your sound
steps.text: What you play is kept by the autosave. To keep a sound, tap SAVE for PRESETS, then again for USER: KNOB1 picks a slot, and KNOB4 (SAVE) turned right twice within about 1.5 s stores it. KNOB2 LOADs, KNOB3 ERASEs.

steps.title: Menu and more
steps.text: Hold HOME for the menu (SCREEN, LIGHTS, AUDIO, SEQ, MIDI, SYS); SYS > ABOUT shows the version. The web editor reaches every parameter. More: github.com/isod89/clipper-fm1 (README and QUICKSTART).
